ModMetaData.name: JB Framework Sample A
ModMetaData.author: Julius Berger
ModMetaData.description: Test and example mod for JB Framework (a dependent mod). Not for players. Registers sections (one per DLC/mod case), one setting of every kind, presets, compatibility entries, a custom page, a theme and the welcome card, with per-save values. Built and tested on RimWorld 1.7. The 1.6 build is best effort and untested.
